identification.summary: MAGNETIC SPIDER is a CrowdStrike-style adversary designator (the SPIDER suffix denotes eCrime in CrowdStrike naming). Searches found no CrowdStrike profile, vendor report or news article describing its activity. CrowdStrike's 2015-02-10 Global Threat Intel Report covered 2014 cybercrime and targeted-intrusion trends and tracked 39 adversary groups [S1]; this record's evidence that the name appears in that report is unverified.
identification.notes: The record's country field says RU, but no source gathered supports it. Do not merge facts from other adversary names into this record without the primary report.

gaps: No vendor profile, report body text or news article describing MAGNETIC SPIDER activity, TTPs, targets or campaigns was found in 6 searches.
Unresolved whether MAGNETIC SPIDER is a distinct actor or a mislabeled synonym of the PANDA names; country (RU in record) is unverified.
No MITRE ATT&CK group, Microsoft mapping or government attribution was found.
The only claimed evidence of the name (a Malpedia listing, formerly S2) could not be verified in fact-check searches and was removed.

sources.title: CrowdStrike Global Threat Intel Report Analyzes Cybercrime and Targeted Intrusion Trends of 2014
